3455 mukaomai {moo-kah'-om-ahee}

源自可能是 muzo (哞哞叫) 的衍生字; 動詞

欽定本 - roar 1; 1

1) 獅子的吼叫 (#啟 10:3|)
record.edic_text:
3455 mukaomai {moo-kah'-om-ahee}

from a presumed derivative of muzo ( to "moo");; v

AV - roar 1; 1

1) to low, bellow, properly of horned cattle
2) to roar, of a lion
